subject: How to implement a try catch in lavaan error

messages.author: c89471eda5dca12c
messages.subject: How to implement a try catch in lavaan error
parts:
Hello

I have a dataset with 23.000 records and I build a procedure to model a PA  using lavaan each 1.000 records because I would like to see the different results according sample size

So my function basically do:

for(data.size in seq(1000, 2000, by = 1000))
{

  pa.model.fit    <- lavaan::sem(paModel, sample.cov = data.cor, sample.nobs = nrow(data.to.work of data.size))
  pa.std.param    <- lavaan::standardizedSolution(pa.model.fit) #standardized parameters
  pa.fit.measures <- lavaan::fitMeasures(pa.model.fit)

}

so when reach 5.000 records the model did not converge and stop all process

How I would implement a trycatch error on this case, like

if did not converge with 5.000 records try with 6.000. 7.000...

This is the error message:


Error in lav_fit_measures(object = object, fit.measures = fit.measures, : 
  lavaan ERROR: fit measures not available if model did not converge
In addition: There were 22 warnings (use warnings() to see them)

Tks

messages.author: ad188126f9138663
messages.subject: Re: How to implement a try catch in lavaan error
parts:
Ellas,
Note that seq(1000, 2000, by=1000) is the same as c(1000, 2000).

Also, note that supplying a sample.cov and changing the sample.nobs does not recompute the sample.cov based on sample.nobs.


require(lavaan)

myModel <- '
  Factor =~ x1 + x2 + x3
  Factor ~~ 1*Factor
  x1 ~~ x1
  x2 ~~ x2
  x3 ~~ x3
  '

myOutput <- list()         # Initiallize empty list to collect output
for(data.size in seq(200,350,by=50)){   # Note: data set has only 301 cases
  tryCatch({
    data.cov <- cov(HolzingerSwineford1939[1:data.size,7:9])
    myFit <- sem(myModel, sample.cov=data.cov, sample.nobs=data.size)
    myOutput <- append(myOutput, myFit)
  })
}
myOutput  # Output contains fit for 200, 250, and 300 but not 350, which produced an error

Keith
